Petition of Boston Gas Company and the former Colonial Gas Company, each d/b/a National Grid, pursuant to G.L. c. 164, § 145, for review and approval of the reconciliation of its 2021 Gas System Enhancement Plan and for review and approval of its Gas System Enhancement Reconciliation Adjustment Factor. Testimony and Exhibits of the Company’s witness Amy Smith: Exhibits NG-AS-1 through NG-AS-13, including redacted copies of Exhibits NG-AS-10 and NG-AS-10A.
